name: Stagette
source:
An intense adult mystery about youth gone horribly wrong.

It's been some time since Rina Kuriyama (25) was murdered by her boyfriend. One day, her younger sister Reina (14) kidnaps a classmate and violently holds her captive. That same morning before kidnapping the girl, Reina meets Kanako Saeki (25), an old friend of Rina's, hands her "a human body part," then runs off without explanation.

While Reina holds her classmate hostage somewhere unknown, Kanako and her friends desperately search for Reina's location. They also argue over what to do with the disturbing "body part" they've received. Following a clue they find along the way, Kanako's group meets with "a certain man"...

Rina Kuriyama hated Kanako and her friends before she died. Her murder and Reina's kidnapping aren't unrelated events. Why was Rina killed? Why did she resent Kanako's group so much? Why did Reina kidnap her classmate—and why give away that body part?

Connections emerge between Reina's classmate victim, Rina's murderer, "the certain man," and Reina herself—and all point toward Reina's tragic past. Adults struggling with suffocating lives; uncertain futures; unforgettable traumas... All these painful mysteries connect as summer cruelly comes to an end.

This is the final youthful rebellion of adults who can't grow up—and the last summer for a girl who's given up on ever becoming an adult herself.

When you truly become an adult, you accept life's boredom. Sparkling youth won't come again—so let's make one last reckless memory together.

Stagette. Everyone eventually grows up...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/12214]freem[/url]]
translation:
一部紧张刺激的成人向悬疑作品，讲述青春如何走向惨痛失控。

Rina Kuriyama（25岁）被男友杀害已过去一段时间。某天，她的妹妹Reina（14岁）绑架了一名同学，并将她残暴地囚禁起来。绑架发生当天清晨，Reina先遇见了Rina的旧友Kanako Saeki（25岁），交给她“一块人体部位”，随后一言不发地跑开。

Reina把同学囚禁在某个未知地点期间，Kanako和朋友们拼命寻找她的下落。他们也争论该如何处置收到的那块骇人“人体部位”。沿着途中发现的线索，Kanako一行人遇见了“某个男人”……

Rina生前一直憎恨Kanako和她的朋友。Rina被杀与Reina绑架同学并非毫无关联。Rina为何被杀？她为何如此怨恨Kanako一行人？Reina为何绑架同学，又为何送出那块人体部位？

Reina被绑架的同学、Rina的凶手、“那个男人”和Reina之间的关联逐渐浮现，一切都指向Reina悲惨的过去。成年人被令人窒息的生活所困，前途未卜，创伤难以磨灭……这些痛苦的谜团彼此相连，直到夏日残酷地落幕。

这是拒绝长大的成年人最后一次青春叛逆，也是一个放弃成为大人的女孩最后一个夏天。

真正长大后，人们便学会接受生活的乏味。闪耀的青春不会重来……不如一起留下最后一段任性的回忆吧。

《Stagette》：每个人终究都会长大……
